faq.name: faq
faq.label: FAQ
faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.description: Everything you need to know about creating pet art with PetArt Studio.

items.title: What types of pets can I create art for?
items.description: PetArt works with all types of pets - dogs, cats, birds, rabbits, hamsters, horses, and more! As long as you have a clear photo of your pet, we can transform it into beautiful art.

items.title: What photo quality do I need for best results?
items.description: For best results, use a clear, well-lit photo where your pet's face is clearly visible. The photo should be at least 500x500 pixels. Avoid blurry or dark photos for optimal art generation.

items.title: How long does it take to generate pet art?
items.description: Our AI creates your pet portrait in just 10-30 seconds! Once generated, you can immediately download the high-resolution image for printing or sharing.

items.title: Can I use the generated art for commercial purposes?
items.description: Yes! Once you generate art with PetArt, you own full rights to use it however you wish - personal use, gifts, merchandise, or commercial purposes.

items.title: What resolution are the generated images?
items.description: All generated pet portraits are high-resolution images suitable for printing. The exact resolution depends on your selected aspect ratio, but all images are optimized for both digital display and physical printing.

items.title: Do you offer refunds if I'm not satisfied?
items.description: Yes! We offer a 100% satisfaction guarantee. If you're not happy with your generated pet art, contact our support team for a full refund or additional credits to try again.
